overall_policy.description: Dundee publishes UK school-leaver academic requirements, UCAT requirement, English language requirements, and contextual admissions policy. International Stage 2 guidance is modelled separately; Home Stage 2 logic remains unchanged.
not_eligible_if: Current undergraduate students are not considered, except final-year students applying through the graduate route.
Applicants must have evidence of academic study within the three years before starting medicine.

grade_requirements.notes: For A-level applicants, Biology is required at GCSE grade 7.
For A-level applicants, Chemistry is required at GCSE grade 7.
For SQA applicants, Biology is required at National 5 grade A where Biology is not studied at Higher.
For SQA applicants, Chemistry is required at National 5 grade A where Chemistry is not studied at Higher.
English is required at GCSE grade 6 or National 5 grade B if not studied at A-level or Higher.
Mathematics is required at GCSE grade 6 or National 5 grade B if not studied at A-level or Higher.

gcse.notes: Dundee's GCSE/National 5 requirements are route-dependent and should be evaluated alongside the applicant's post-16 qualification route. For SQA applicants, Biology/Chemistry National 5 grade A applies to the counterpart subject not studied at Higher. ApplySmart may use National 5 strength for estimated Home guidance differentiation, but Dundee's exact academic scoring conversion is unpublished.

national_5.notes: SQA applicants need National 5 grade A in the Biology/Chemistry counterpart subject when that subject is not studied at Higher. English and Mathematics are required at National 5 grade B if not studied at Higher.

Grades must include 80% in key subjects.

ucat.notes: All applicants must sit UCAT in the year of application. Dundee states there is no minimum UCAT cut-off score.

international_selection.notes: International applicants are ranked separately using 60% academics and 40% UCAT national decile rank. UCAT uses the cognitive total only. Historical guidance is not a fixed UCAT cut-off.

ranking_factors.notes: School-leaver academic and UCAT weighting is FOI-supported at 60% academic and 40% UCAT. Historical admissions statistics include invited-to-interview UCAT data for display/context only; exact academic conversion and current Dundee applicant-pool UCAT decile boundaries are not public.

output_band_policy.notes: Bands are medium-confidence ApplySmart guidance from historical data and the clearly labelled research model. International bands use verified historical international evidence. They are not fixed Dundee UCAT cut-offs.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: Home school-leaver weighting is FOI-supported at 60% academic and 40% UCAT, but the exact Dundee academic conversion table and current applicant-pool UCAT decile boundaries are not public. For international applicants, verified evidence records a separate pool, 60% academic and 40% UCAT weighting, national-decile ranking using cognitive total only, no fixed UCAT cut-off, and no personal-statement shortlisting.

contextual_eligibility.notes: Dundee A100 contextual/widening-access routing is activated only from structured Step 6 contextual evidence via the shared contextual eligibility framework. Raw legacy contextual flags or raw applicant-group IDs must not independently unlock Dundee contextual, widening-access, RUK contextual or Scottish contextual routes. ApplySmart stores Category 1 and Category 2 metadata where directly evidenced from Dundee's published criteria, but this is not presented as Dundee having confirmed an applicant's internal category. Possible internal upgrading of multiple Category 2 factors is not inferred.

validation.review_notes: Home eligibility now includes Dundee-specific contextual activation and Scottish standard/widening-access academic route support. FOI-supported school-leaver weighting is 60% academic and 40% UCAT, but Home prediction is ApplySmart-derived tier guidance because exact academic conversion and current Dundee applicant-pool UCAT decile boundaries are not public. Verified international evidence supports a separate 60% academic and 40% national-decile UCAT pool, historical interview guidance, a two-stage hybrid interview and interview-only offer ranking.
